flags.why: Bàn thảo means to discuss or deliberate and does not imply reaching a conclusion.
Thí can mean sacrificing a piece or person for an advantage, without being in a tight spot.
flags.fix: to sacrifice (a piece, a person) for a tactical advantage

flags.why: Bàn là is mainly Northern usage and needs a regional label.
This sense of vô đạo belongs to literary language and would sound unusual in ordinary casual speech.
The example defines a centaur instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Con nhân mã giương cung nhắm vào mục tiêu. = The centaur raised its bow and aimed at the target.
